column1: # Any rule not listed here keeps ZAP's default baseline behaviour (WARN),
# which never fails the scan (see quality-gates.yml's `cmd_options: '-I'`).
# IMPORTANT — zap_common.py's load_config keys config_dict by the alert's
# bare `pluginId` (e.g. "90004"), not by the finer-grained `alertRef` shown
# in ZAP's docs pages (e.g. "90004-3" for COOP, "90004-2" for COEP). A rules
# file entry keyed "90004-3" is silently never matched — verified empirically
# against this project's own PR canhoto (2 rounds of that exact mistake).
# Plugin 90004 also bundles COOP+COEP+CORP under one pluginId, and this app
# doesn't set CORP, so promoting bare "90004" would make this gate
# 10021 (X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing) has no such sub-id — it's a
# single, cleanly matchable pluginId — so it's the gate instead: a real,
# preview.headers) that this project actually ships.
